name: project-perception
title: Project Perception
summary: Connect AI agents to specialized security workflows for investigation, threat intelligence, reconnaissance, posture analysis, and identity risk assessment.
description: The Project Perception MCP server connects MCP-compatible AI agents and orchestration platforms to specialized Perception security workflows. Agents can discover available playbooks, launch and monitor asynchronous investigation sessions, provide follow-up guidance, and retrieve summaries and generated Markdown reports. Sessions remain available in Microsoft Defender.

useCases.name: Recon Agent
useCases.description: Performs attacker scouting activities to map your environment, surface attack paths, choke points, valuable assets, configuration issues, and excess permissions.

useCases.name: Triage Agent
useCases.description: Classifies and resolves alerts as true or false positives, with detailed explanations behind its conclusions. It learns from context and feedback to improve accuracy over time.

useCases.name: Threat Intelligence Agent
useCases.description: Extracts attack patterns, indicators, and key threat intelligence objects, then analyzes them to identify how to defend against or respond to a threat.

useCases.name: Attack Investigation Agent
useCases.description: Reconstructs the full attack story by correlating alerts, incidents, and security signals. It provides analyst-ready insights, including verdicts, timelines, techniques, indicators of compromise, and affected entities.

useCases.name: Detection Authoring Agent
useCases.description: Identifies gaps in threat coverage and creates detection rules to improve defenses as threats evolve.

useCases.name: Posture Prioritization Agent
useCases.description: Ranks posture issues by real-world risk, exposure, exploitability, and asset criticality. It provides focused guidance on what to fix first and why.

perceptionOAuth.description: Authenticate with the Microsoft identity platform using OAuth2 authorization code flow with PKCE support.
